top_signals.title: Hasty US exit from Europe could drive allies away from American arms, RAND says
top_signals.summary: A rapid, uncoordinated U.S. military drawdown from Europe could push key NATO allies further away from American weapons, a RAND study found.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Jersey Mike's CEO on 3Q Earnings, Expansion Plans
top_signals.summary: Jersey Mike’s shares rose after the company beat third-quarter earnings expectations. CEO Charlie Morrison, discussing the brand’s first full earnings report since going public, said same-store sales increased about 3% and he believes the growth is sustainable. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close" on October 28, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
